description: This file provides Macedonian localization (i18n) strings for the Select2 jQuery plugin, version 4.0.6-rc.1. It defines the translations for messages displayed during user interactions such as input length validation, loading results, maximum selection, and search no results.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the user has entered too many characters, specifying how many characters to remove.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns a message prompting the user to enter more characters, indicating how many more are needed.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns a message indicating that more results are being loaded.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the maximum number of items that can be selected.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns a message indicating no matching results were found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns a message indicating that a search is in progress.
